title: Draw a square
prompt: The robot draws by driving, and `forward` and `left` already exist. Drive a square: eight instructions in all.

tests.name: Eight instructions: forward, left, four times

hints: A square is the same corner four times, and one corner is forward() then left().
Write that pair four times in run, eight lines in all.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

solution:
func run():
	forward()
	left()
	forward()
	left()
	forward()
	left()
	forward()
	left()

func forward():
	print("forward 30")

func left():
	print("left")
